opening.title: One Voice Can Create Change
opening.description: Business OS helps people organize, collaborate and act together with transparency.
opening.narration: Every meaningful change starts when people choose to organize and act together. VoiceUp brings leadership and participation into one trusted flow.

problem.title: People care. Action often breaks down.
problem.description: Momentum gets lost when people, communication, volunteers, funds, and follow-up stay disconnected.
problem.narration: Good intentions are common, but disconnected tools create confusion. Business OS connects people, tasks, evidence, and progress in one place.

organize.title: Organize people around shared purpose
organize.description: Build structure, assign roles, and coordinate long-term initiatives.
organize.narration: Create organizations, grow core teams, coordinate members and volunteers, and keep everyone focused on the next meaningful action.

initiatives.title: Launch initiatives people can act on
initiatives.description: Move from concern to coordinated public and community action.
initiatives.narration: Create and publish initiatives, invite participation, and keep real-world action moving after the first response.

offlineOnline.title: Connect offline and online effort
offlineOnline.description: Bring paper participation and field evidence into one trusted record.
offlineOnline.narration: Ground activity matters. Digitize signatures, photos, and evidence while preserving history and context.

engagement.title: Inspire action, not just messages
engagement.description: Reach people in the right language and channel with clear next steps.
engagement.narration: Invite people to sign, attend, volunteer, support, and share. Follow up responsibly with measurable responses.

transparency.title: Build trust through transparency
transparency.description: Plan, collect, spend, and report with visible purpose.
transparency.narration: Track budgets, collections, approvals, expenses, and evidence with responsible transparency appropriate for each initiative.

growth.title: Turn support into sustainable momentum
growth.description: Align partners, volunteers, leaders, sponsors, and communities through clear roles.
growth.narration: Coordinate people and partnerships with shared goals, measurable progress, and transparent recognition.

impact.title: See real-world impact
impact.description: Understand what changed because people acted together.
impact.narration: Track participation, volunteers, transparent fund usage, events, and outcomes. Use real records to guide next decisions.

decision.title: What do you want to start today?
decision.description: Choose your path: organize leadership or act immediately.
decision.narration: Choose Organize to build structure and lead long-term initiatives. Choose Act to join, support, volunteer, and help now.

publicCampaign.title: Understand this campaign
publicCampaign.subtitle: A concise explanation of the cause, participation, and next steps.

objective.title: Campaign objective
objective.description: Understand the change this campaign is asking for.
objective.narration: Start with the campaign objective. Read the organizer's published description to understand the requested change, affected community, and intended public outcome.

evidence.title: Evidence and background
evidence.description: Review the context the organizer has made available.
evidence.narration: Consider the published background and any supporting material shown on this page. If evidence is not provided, seek additional context before deciding to participate.

progress.title: Campaign progress
progress.description: Follow verified participation toward the stated goal.
progress.narration: Campaign progress reflects the participation recorded by VoiceUp. The visible goal and verified supporter count help you understand current momentum without predicting the final result.

afterSigning.title: What happens after signing
afterSigning.description: Your submitted support joins the campaign review flow.
afterSigning.narration: After signing, the submitted record follows the campaign's verification flow. The campaign team can use verified participation to prepare responsible updates and authority communication.

share.title: Share responsibly
share.description: Help others understand the campaign before they participate.
share.narration: Sharing can help the campaign reach more people. Use the provided campaign link, keep the original context intact, and invite others to make their own informed decision.

volunteerUpdates.title: Volunteer and follow updates
volunteerUpdates.description: Stay connected through the options the organizer provides.
volunteerUpdates.narration: If volunteer or update options are available, use the organizer's published channels. Do not assume an activity is active unless it is clearly shown on the campaign page.

campaignAdmin.title: Grow this campaign step by step
campaignAdmin.subtitle: Follow the next practical actions from publishing to measurable public impact.

publishStrengthen.title: Publish and strengthen the campaign
publishStrengthen.description: Review the public experience and improve campaign readiness.
publishStrengthen.narration: Start by reviewing the campaign message, authority, location, supporter form, and public presentation. Publish only when the request is clear and the campaign is ready.

paperSignatures.title: Digitize paper signatures
paperSignatures.description: Review field records before they enter the supporter journey.
paperSignatures.narration: Bring paper supporter records into the existing review flow. Correct captured details, check possible duplicates, and approve each record carefully before verification.

crm.title: Build the supporter CRM
crm.description: Organize participation and follow-up context in one place.
crm.narration: Use the supporter CRM to understand who has joined, where participation is growing, and which records need review before responsible follow-up.

referrals.title: Grow through referrals
referrals.description: Understand how trusted sharing expands campaign reach.
referrals.narration: Referral signals show how supporters help a campaign travel through trusted networks. Use them to recognize responsible participation without treating projected reach as guaranteed impact.

volunteers.title: Organize volunteers
volunteers.description: Coordinate field participation and local campaign activity.
volunteers.narration: Volunteer coordination connects field work with campaign outcomes. Use available activity and location context to plan collection, sharing, and follow-up responsibly.

reportsImpact.title: Track reports and impact
reportsImpact.description: Turn campaign activity into clear operational insight.
reportsImpact.narration: Review reports to understand supporter activity, verification, locations, and campaign progress. Use measured results for decisions rather than relying on assumptions.

evidenceUpdates.title: Publish evidence and updates
evidenceUpdates.description: Keep the public campaign story current and accountable.
evidenceUpdates.narration: Use the public campaign experience to present accurate context and updates. Publish only material the campaign can support, and keep dynamic campaign content under human control.

fundraising.title: Prepare transparent fundraising
fundraising.description: Explain funding needs without overstating available services.
fundraising.narration: When fundraising is appropriate, present the purpose, payment information, and expectations clearly. Treat transparency as essential and use only the configured campaign controls.

districts.title: Coordinate districts
districts.description: See where participation is growing and where support is needed.
districts.narration: District and local participation context can guide field coordination. Compare real campaign records, identify coverage gaps, and plan outreach without inventing activity.

aiCopilot.title: Use AI Campaign Copilot
aiCopilot.description: Improve campaign content while keeping human review in control.
aiCopilot.narration: Use the AI Campaign Copilot to improve wording and consider next steps. Review every suggestion before applying it to a live campaign.

faq.title: Built for teams that need trust before scale.

quickLaunch.question: Can a non-technical team launch a campaign quickly?
quickLaunch.answer: Yes. Voiceup is designed around guided setup, AI-assisted copy, templates, public links, QR sharing, and publish checks so teams can move fast.

freeTrial.question: Is the 1-day trial really free?
freeTrial.answer: The landing flow presents a 1-day free trial path for one campaign with Voiceup branding and limited supporter collection. Paid upgrades can be configured when the team is ready.

offlineSupport.question: Can campaigns collect support offline?
offlineSupport.answer: Yes. Voiceup supports online signatures, QR-based collection, and paper/scan workflows for field teams and community events.

outsideIndia.question: Does Voiceup work outside India?
outsideIndia.answer: Yes. Global mode supports country, state or province, city or district, locality or ward, and postal/ZIP fields while India detailed mode remains available.

smallOrganization.question: Can pricing fit a small organization?
smallOrganization.answer: Yes. The plan ladder starts with a free trial and Starter plan, then grows into Growth, Pro Movement, and Enterprise options as campaign scale increases.
